[IARC.7.1.1] **`libds.a` is built with `-fPIC`.** Required so
the archive can link into Python's `pyds` C extension (a
shared object). Standalone test binaries
link the same archive without trouble — PIC is a superset of
non-PIC. `libds.build` ([IARC.10.1.7]) sets the flag
unconditionally on every compile of the archive's objects; do not
remove it without checking that the pyds extension still links.
